cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded, and it names no format.

Muninn's catalogue lists only three decisions: HTTPS everywhere, certificate verification on in all builds, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. A `muninn why` query on the wire format returned "insufficient". The only related-looking hit was an unlabelled one-word "zstd" reply from an earlier session, which is a compression name and not a recorded serialisation decision.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. The file exists with the intended content.
